title: Before spawning work, search for an existing build of it (process rule, every standing session)
ruling: Owner words, 18:18 CST Nov 15 (RELAYED, verbatim as the consultant relayed them, typos kept): "im 10000% sure a pr already exists that rors that. u need to (abd all standing sessions frankly)) eed to first see if what they dpawn hasnt already been built somewhere before just starting it again". Context: the consultant had said it would queue a step for CI runs whose base is older than a revert on main (debt draft stale-merge-ref-ready-red). Consultant's reading, NOT the owner's words: a standing rule for every standing session: before spawning work, search open and closed PRs, branches and main for an existing build of it. PROCESS RULE (process-only, no code asked). Step: spawn-searches-existing-builds. Second owner chat, 18:33 CST Nov 15 (verbatim as relayed, RELAYED, not read by triage as typed): "this guidance itself needs to be mechanized via a hook thats prob alrdy been built and if not u build it w subagents and see it thru main". "This guidance" is the 18:18 search-before-spawn ruling above (the consultant's reading). So the rule is to be mechanized as a hook, found first if one already exists, else built with subagents and seen through to main; the consultant takes it (step spawn-searches-existing-builds).
